algorithm: Select personal exemption from Table A by annualized salary and withholding code.
Subtract the exemption and calculate initial progressive tax from Table B.
Add the Table C two-percent-rate phase-out amount.
Add the Table D tax recapture amount.
Apply the Table E personal-tax-credit decimal.
Deannualize, add CT-W4 line 2, subtract line 3, and clamp at zero.
specialRules: There is no general percentage shortcut; use the calculation rules or withholding tables.
Nonresident wages may require apportionment and convenience-of-employer treatment.
Certain lump-sum retirement-distribution mandatory withholding is suspended through December 31, 2026 unless requested.
